self_critique:
The run found a real-looking gain (+0.00246 over baseline), but the search was shallow and poorly attributable.

Harness/policy issues:
- Node_001 made an overfitting diagnosis despite telemetry later being declared unusable. The policy should have rejected that rationale rather than allowing unsupported curve interpretation.
- Node_001 and node_003 bundled many changes at once. This improved the score but provided little evidence about which components mattered or whether interactions were necessary.
- Effect forecasts were poorly calibrated. Node_002 predicted +0.0026 but delivered roughly +0.0004; node_003 predicted +0.0023 but delivered roughly +0.0015 over its parent.
- Node_002 scored above its parent yet was rejected, with no uncertainty, gate threshold, or rejection reason recorded. The journal should expose seed variance, confidence bounds, and the exact acceptance rule.
- Convergence after only three children was premature. No replication, ablation, or local refinement of the winning Sequence DeepFM package was attempted.
- The two-seed mean-logit close confounds architectural improvement with ensembling. Its compute and score should be compared against an equally seeded parent.
- “Signal is effectively flat” was inconsistent with the observed gains and encouraged a large speculative jump rather than a controlled test.

Scaffold changes:
- Validate telemetry before generating diagnoses; otherwise force a telemetry-agnostic hypothesis.
- Prefer one-factor or staged experiments, with bundles allowed only after component evidence exists.
- Evaluate parent and child on matched seeds and report mean, standard deviation, confidence interval, actual delta, and forecast error.
- Separate single-model selection from ensemble gains and enforce compute-matched comparisons.
- Require at least one replication and one ablation before declaring convergence.
- Record explicit rejection reasons and preserve promising rejected candidates for follow-up.

Next run:
First reproduce node_003 against node_001 over 3–5 matched seeds using single-model inference. If the gain survives, ablate the winning package in this order: causal author history, session/time/tab context, censor-aware watch-time auxiliary, then model-family change. Only after identifying a robust single-model improvement should the run retest mean-logit ensembling.
